tagline.en_US: Installs a set of Arr applications at once, each in its own unprivileged LXC. Prowlarr, Sonarr, Radarr and qBittorrent come selected; Lidarr, Bazarr, SABnzbd, Seerr and Unpackerr can be added. The media applications share one host folder, and Jellyfin, Plex or Emby can be added as the media server. Each container starts on its own: there is no main member.

description.en_US: Suite Arr sets up a complete media automation in one go, with each application in its own unprivileged LXC: Prowlarr manages the indexers for the others, Sonarr and Radarr find and organize TV series and movies, and qBittorrent downloads them. Lidarr for music, Bazarr for subtitles, SABnzbd for Usenet, Seerr for requests and Unpackerr for extracting downloads can be added, and Jellyfin, Plex or Emby can serve the library. The media applications share one host folder, so downloads and libraries stay in the same place.
